defs.def: a large area of land, usually in the country, that is owned by one person or family （通常指农村的）大片私有土地，庄园

ex.s: As the summer months roll in, our Georgian country estate makes the perfect setting for an outdoor fitness session.
ex.t: 来吧，在我们的合格私人教练乔迪·麦格雷戈的带领下，在米德尔顿庄园的场地上锻炼。

ex.s: Come and work out with our qualified personal trainer, Jodie McGregor, on the grounds of the Middleton Lodge estate.
ex.t: 来和我们的合格私人教练乔迪·麦格雷戈一起，在米德尔顿洛奇庄园的场地上锻炼吧。

defs.def: an area of land with a lot of houses or factories of the same type on it 住宅区；工业区；工厂区

ex.s: The nursing home, located on a housing estate, has more than 150 senior citizens, some of whom are over 90 years old.
ex.t: 这家养老院坐落在一个住宅区内，住着 150 多位老人，其中一些已经超过 90 岁了。

ex.s: After he graduated in architecture, he in real estate.
ex.t: 他建筑学专业毕业后，从事了房地产行业。

defs.def: all the money and property that a person owns, especially everything that is left when they die 个人财产；（尤指）遗产
